title: Follow-up Emails
meta: Instant replies and timed reminders that go out after each new lead, written and set up for you. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Follow-up emails that reply to every new lead
overview: Leads go cold fast, and the first reply often wins the job. We write and automate the messages that go out after each enquiry: an instant thank-you that sets expectations, a helpful follow-up if they have not replied, and a gentle last check. They are built in your own email tool or CRM, sent from your address, and stop automatically when the lead replies or books. We test the whole sequence before it is switched on.

faq: We write them in plain, personal language and send them from a real person's address, so they read like a quick reply from you. We avoid heavy design on follow-ups.
Which tools can you automate in?
HubSpot, Zoho, Pipedrive, Mailchimp, Klaviyo, ActiveCampaign and most CRMs and email tools. Tell us what you use, and we confirm that the sequence is possible on your plan.
How do you stop people getting emails after they reply?
We build rules that end the sequence when a reply arrives, a meeting is booked or the lead is marked won or lost. We test those rules with a sample lead before going live.
Is it fine to email someone who filled in my form?
Yes, to answer their request. For ongoing marketing, we add clear wording to the form and an unsubscribe link, and we keep follow-ups relevant to what they asked about.
